snippet.title: Macaulay Culkin on Catherine O'Hara's Death: "I Owed Her a Favor"
snippet.description:
Macaulay Culkin is opening up about the death of his "Home Alone" on-screen mother, Catherine O'Hara, who passed away on January 30 at age 71 .

"When Catherine passed away in January, that hit me," Culkin told Gentleman's Journal. "That hit me pretty good, 'cause, you know, it was just too soon. And I felt that we had unfinished business" .

The 45-year-old actor added: "I feel like I owed her a favor — and I don't like having an outstanding debt" .

Culkin and O'Hara shared an emotional reunion at his Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony in December 2023, where O'Hara joked about being "your fake mom who left you home alone not once, but twice" .

snippet.title: Macaulay Culkin Wipes Away Tears as He Reunites with Home Alone Mom Catherine O'Hara
snippet.description:
In a deeply moving moment, Macaulay Culkin, now 43, shared tears of joy during a heartfelt reunion with his "Home Alone" co-star and onscreen mother, Catherine O'Hara, at his Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony. The event, chronicled by Benjamin VanHoose on December 2, 2023, unfolded as a poignant reflection on the enduring impact of the iconic 1990 film.

As Culkin accepted his star on the illustrious Hollywood Walk of Fame, O'Hara, aged 69, graced the occasion with her presence, delivering a touching speech that resonated with the audience. Expressing both gratitude and humor, O'Hara playfully acknowledged her onscreen character as the "fake mom who left [Culkin] home alone not once but twice." The atmosphere was laden with nostalgia as the actress recalled witnessing Culkin's evolution over the 33 years since the release of "Home Alone."

The ceremony was beautifully captured by Matt Baron/BEI/Shutterstock, encapsulating the emotional reunion between Culkin and O'Hara. O'Hara emphasized the enduring global legacy of "Home Alone," declaring it a beloved sensation that continues to unite families worldwide. Her words underscored the timeless charm of the film, attributing its perennial popularity to the remarkable talent and enduring presence of Macaulay Culkin.

snippet.title: Catherine O’Hara, ‘Home Alone’ and ‘Schitt’s Creek’ star, dead at 71 #ripbetty #catherineohara
snippet.description:
Catherine O’Hara, the radiant actress whose singular comedic delivery helped elevate movies and TV shows like “Beetlejuice,” “Home Alone” and “Schitt’s Creek” to cult classic status, has died. She was 71.

A statement from CAA, the agency that represented O’Hara, said the actress died Friday “at her home in Los Angeles following a brief illness.”

O’Hara got her start at Second City in her native Canada, before turning to film, where she brought to life two of cinema’s most memorable mothers.In 1988’s “Beetlejuice,” she played Delia Deetz, a devilish mom who made no secret of her love for “Prince Valium” and turned lip syncing into an art form. She reprised the role in 2024’s “Beetlejuice Beetlejuice.”

In 1990’s “Home Alone,” O’Hara turned a one-word movie line (“KEVIN!”) into pop culture history. As a frazzled mom of five who left one of her brood (Macaulay Culkin) at home during their holiday trip to France, O’Hara brought heart and humor to the now classic Christmas movie. A sequel was released in 1992.


Just two years ago, O’Hara showed up to the Walk of Fame ceremony as her on-screen son Culkin received his star.

“Thank you for including me, your fake mom who left you home alone not once, but twice, to share in this happy occasion,” O’Hara told him. “I’m so proud of you.”

snippet.title: Macaulay Culkin reunites with 'Home Alone' mom Catherine O'Hara
snippet.description:
"Kevin!" Catherine O'Hara reunited with herHome Alone son Macaulay Culkin at his Hollywood Walk of Fame star ceremony on Friday, where she delivered a speech that reduced her former costar to tears. The Schitt's Creek star, 69, reflected on watching her onscreen son, 43, grow and evolve in the years since they played Kate and Kevin McCallister in Chris Columbus and John Hughes' 1990 Christmas classic and its 1992 sequel. "Home Alone was, is, and always will be a beloved global sensation," O'Hara began her speech. "The reason families all over the world can't let a year go by without watching and loving Home Alone together is because of Macaulay Culkin."Yes, Culkin had the "most excellent script" and "wonderful director," but it was his "perfect performance" that has made it such an enduring classic, O'Hara continued. "I know you worked really hard, but you made acting look like the most natural thing in the world to do." She later added, "This beautiful 10-year-old little boy was called a superstar, a moneymaker, one of the hottest leading young men in Hollywood. How does anyone survive that?"Catherine O'Hara attends Macaulay Culkin's Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony. John Salangsang/Shutterstock"I believe you'd have to possess a certain quality," O'Hara said. "A gift that dear John Hughes obviously recognized in Macaulay." Of his sense of humor, "It's a sign of intelligence in a child and a key to survival at any age," she added. "You have brought that sense of sweet yet twisted, yet totally relatable, sense of humor to everything you have chosen to do since Home Alone."O'Hara concluded her speech by thanking Culkin for including her, "your fake mom that left you home alone not once but twice," to "share in this happy occasion." After sharing a hug, Culkin wiped away tears. Catherine O'Hara and Macaulay Culkin in 1990's 'Home Alone'.20th Century Fox/Kobal/ShutterstockNatasha Lyonne, a former child star herself and Culkin's Party Monster costar, took the podium after O'Hara to share a speech. Culkin's longtime partner, fellow actor Brenda Song, attended the ceremony with their two children; as did his siblings, Rory and Quinn; his goddaughter, Paris Jackson; and fellow Party Monster actor Seth Green. Culkin also shared a speech of his own, concluding with a famous Kevin McCallister line: "To wrap things up and in the spirit of the holiday season, I just want to say, Merry Christmas, ya filthy animals."Catherine O'Hara and Natasha Lyonne attend Macaulay Culkin's Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony. Amy Sussman/GettyMacaulay Culkin with partner Brenda Song and their son at his Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony. Amy Sussman/GettyWatch the ceremony in full below, ya filthy animals. snippet.title: [충격] 맥컬리 컬킨, '나홀로집에' 엄마 빚고백 😥
snippet.description:
맥컬리 컬킨, '나홀로집에' 엄마 캐서린 오하라에 "갚지 못한 빚 있다" 고백

'나 홀로 집에'의 케빈 맥컬리 컬킨이 극중 엄마 케이트 맥캘리스터 역을 맡았던 캐서린 오하라에 대한 깊은 그리움과 갚지 못한 빚이 있다고 고백했다. 최근 젠틀맨스 저널과의 인터뷰에서 컬킨은 캐서린 오하라가 지난 1월 갑작스럽게 세상을 떠난 것에 대해 큰 충격을 받았으며, 그녀와 끝내 마무리하지 못한 일이 남아 있다고 느꼈다고 밝혔다. 그는 "정말로 그녀와 미처 끝내지 못한 무언가가 있었다고 생각한다. 나는 그녀에게 빚을 진 기분이었다. 갚지 못한 빚이 남아 있는 걸 좋아하지 않는다"라며 솔직한 심경을 전했다. 맥컬리 컬킨과 캐서린 오하라는 1990년 영화 '나 홀로 집에'와 1992년 '나 홀로 집에 2'에서 환상적인 호흡을 맞추며 전 세계적인 사랑을 받았다. 두 사람은 2023년 12월 컬킨의 할리우드 명예의 거리 입성 행사에서 감동적인 재회를 하기도 했는데, 당시 오하라는 컬킨을 극찬하며 "한 번도 아니고 두 번이나 너를 집에 혼자 두고 떠난 가짜 엄마를 초대해줘서 고맙다"고 말하며 그의 성공을 축하했다. 이어진 포옹 장면은 많은 이들에게 뭉클함을 선사했다. 안타깝게도 캐서린 오하라는 지난 1월 30일, 71세를 일기로 세상을 떠났다.

맥컬리 컬킨, '나홀로집에' 엄마 캐서린 오하라에 "갚지 못한 빚 있다" 고백

'나 홀로 집에'의 케빈 맥컬리 컬킨이 극중 엄마 케이트 맥캘리스터 역을 맡았던 캐서린 오하라에 대한 깊은 그리움과 갚지 못한 빚이 있다고 고백했다. 최근 젠틀맨스 저널과의 인터뷰에서 컬킨은 캐서린 오하라가 지난 1월 갑작스럽게 세상을 떠난 것에 대해 큰 충격을 받았으며, 그녀와 끝내 마무리하지 못한 일이 남아 있다고 느꼈다고 밝혔다. 그는 "정말로 그녀와 미처 끝내지 못한 무언가가 있었다고 생각한다. 나는 그녀에게 빚을 진 기분이었다. 갚지 못한 빚이 남아 있는 걸 좋아하지 않는다"라며 솔직한 심경을 전했다. 맥컬리 컬킨과 캐서린 오하라는 1990년 영화 '나 홀로 집에'와 1992년 '나 홀로 집에 2'에서 환상적인 호흡을 맞추며 전 세계적인 사랑을 받았다. 두 사람은 2023년 12월 컬킨의 할리우드 명예의 거리 입성 행사에서 감동적인 재회를 하기도 했는데, 당시 오하라는 컬킨을 극찬하며 "한 번도 아니고 두 번이나 너를 집에 혼자 두고 떠난 가짜 엄마를 초대해줘서 고맙다"고 말하며 그의 성공을 축하했다. 이어진 포옹 장면은 많은 이들에게 뭉클함을 선사했다. 안타깝게도 캐서린 오하라는 지난 1월 30일, 71세를 일기로 세상을 떠났다.

snippet.title: Macaulay Culkin's Tearful Reunion with Catherine O'Hara at Walk of Fame Ceremony | Reed Crown
snippet.description:
Macaulay Culkin's Tearful Reunion with Catherine O'Hara at Walk of Fame Ceremony | Reed Crown

"Thank you for including me, your fake mom who left you home alone not once but twice, to share in this happy occasion," the actress said Macaulay Culkin reunited with onscreen mom Catherine O'Hara three decades after Home Alone.

As Culkin, 43, received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Friday, O'Hara, 69, attended to give a speech at the ceremony, looking back at witnessing the actor evolve in the 33 years since 1990's Home Alone.

"Home Alone was, is and always will be a beloved global sensation ... the reason families all over the world can't let a year go by without watching and loving Home Alone together is because of Macaulay Culkin."
